headline: TRITN jumps 50.00% intraday after filing to establish a subsidiary.
market_take: Construction and Property stocks led the market with several double‑digit gains, while Food saw strong volume spikes across multiple names. Unusual trading was widespread, highlighted by TRITN’s 50% surge and AIMCG’s 14.47% intraday rise. Several companies disclosed capital changes, management updates and a new joint venture, adding to the activity.

sector_notes.note: TRITN surged 50.00% intraday with a 0.67× volume ratio; TPOLY fell -10.00% on an opening gap and posted a 7.6σ volume spike; SQ opened down 5.26% and received a demand letter for debt payment.
STELLA rose 15.38% on a 3.19× volume ratio and PRECHA gained 13.89% on 3.47× volume; AKS received a trading sign from SET indicating possible delisting.
AIMCG posted a 14.47% intraday rise with a 7.4σ volume spike; TTLPF and CPNCG disclosed capital reductions, and TTLPF also reported a 4th capital reduction registration.
CHOTI, TC, PB and TWPC each recorded volume spikes above 6σ; MADAME announced a new joint venture; CPF reported a capital decrease.
TL and VPO both rose about 4.65% with solid volume; TEGH and SMO showed volume spikes of 5.1σ and 3.5σ respectively.
PPP gained 5.26% on modest volume; DCON opened down 5.26% on a price gap.
